Chapter 6918: World Rebuilding

Chapter 6918: World Rebuilding

“Ahh...” Guangmai let out one last cry at the end of the refinement.

The liquid of life was the size of an ocean. It brimmed with life and endless possibilities. Just the immortals from Devouring Alliance alone contained incredible essences.

One immortal, once dead, could nourish a world for eras to come. Just one piece of bone was more than enough. Although such a world couldn’t compare to the major ones, it would still be immensely prosperous.

For example, this phenomenon could have greatly strengthened the nine worlds. Therefore, the whole ocean was enough to create a new major world.

“Go, back to the world.” Li Qiye waved his hand and the world’s heart flew into the ocean.

The heart grew bright with endless life force and let out strong beats. It awakened and reached a strength beyond imagination.

The world’s heart split into three parts - time, space, and living beings.

A dead major world couldn’t be saved due to the life force required. One or two immortals was far than enough. However, these hearts could do it with the help of the liquid of life.

“Buzz.” The fabrics of time began again with the heart of time, flowing from the present to the past. The empty shell grew once more, creating rippling spatial dimensions through the heart of space

“Rumble!” With space and time in the picture, planets returned to Stygian. Continents and oceans came next.

Finally, the heart of living beings birthed life. It wasn’t creating life but merely molding them from the liquid of life.

In the past, life took on various forms such as trees, rocks, and people. They were devoured by the immortals of Devouring Alliance. Now, Li Qiye turned these life forces back into liquid, allowing the heart to function properly.

The derivation of life ensued. A vine slowly grew out of a crack in a boulder. On the cliffside, the liquid formed a seed in the soil, slowly sprouting. In an ocean, a speck of life started as the first of its kind...

Time then formed the long river, and as it flowed, even the smallest lives multiplied and thrived, evolving and transforming. Space built the worlds, allowing one tiny life after another to be born and flourish, giving each a realm of its own—lands and skies that nurtured the birth and growth of life...

Evolution began for both planets and living beings. The world of death gradually changed into a place of light and life.

“Back to the source and onward with life, this is eternal.” Li Qiye controlled the primordial tree and chanted a mantra to connect everything.

“Boom!” A primordial tree emerged and filled this world with primordial chaos true energy.

With everything in place, the heart of time and the heart of space returned to where they should be. The heart of living beings entered the tree; the latter returned to Golden Lamp but still left an afterimage in the outer world. Thus, anyone could look up and see it during their dao journey.

Meanwhile, immortals outside only saw faint outlines through the barriers. They felt a majestic life force and the flow of various affinities once more.

They also sensed new lifeforms, meaning that a new world was coming into being.

“Boom!” Their trees also harmonized with Golden Lamp’s tree during the process.
